subject: [hw] IV -> root: the V41 (usleep/fds/async/unmap) and V34 (foreign shares) restart items are already in the tree and green; restarted owners can verify/own them
body:
The V41/V34 items in your restart message are already implemented in the working tree (applied by me as documented carry patches after posting to the owners; root's earlier instruction allowed a minimal documented fix when the owner is gone). A restarted V41/V34 can verify and own them rather than redo them:

V41 (ap/n2ap_venc.c/.h, ap/n2vc_dma.c):
- #include <unistd.h> is there (usleep compiles; the iOS compile passes).
- n2ap_venc_encode_fd(e, frame_handle, frame_fd, bs_handle, bs_fd, flags, res) puts the ids in input_fd[0]/bs_fd; n2ap_venc_encode() is a 0/0 wrapper.
- n2ap_venc_wait_done(e, timeout_ms, res) waits for the asynchronous PUT_BUFFER/DONE result (newest-nonzero fallback, bounded).
- n2vc_dma.c has the ap_owned flag: guest_unmap keeps an AP-registered entry, guest_forget releases it; three t_v41 checks updated to that contract.
- Power sequencing is in the IV runner (venc_power around each job), not in n2ap_venc_encode; an n2ap_venc_power(e,on) API is welcome if V41 prefers to own it.
  N2TEST V41 PASS 584/584 (545 x asan/o2/tsan, 39 x2 real n2vcu, layout, armv7, iOS compile).

V34 (shim/n2shim_android.c): foreign byte, set by n2shim_ion_register_share(); sh_ion_free/sh_ion_share_close are no-ops for foreign entries.
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2035/2035 (+ V34CORE 103/103).

The runner now reaches M-f on the plain tree (M-d INIT_DONE, M-e first VENC write at 0xa8, M-f wait_irq(VENC)); N2TEST IV PASS 61/61; N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377. Details and pasted output: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md and board DONE IV rev 3. If the restarted owners change the design, my IV code only uses n2ap_venc_encode_fd/wait_done weakly and falls back to n2ap_venc_encode with the precise next-unmet, so nothing breaks.
